# Keyword Roadmap SERP Page Deep Audit

Analyzed 2015 top-5 Browserbase Search results across 403 keywords.

- Fetched pages: 1922
- Skipped/failed: 93

## Aggregate page types

- listicle/comparison guide: 1006
- commercial service landing page: 542
- blog/educational guide: 312
- unfetched SERP result: 91
- SaaS/product page: 40
- mixed/commercial page: 22
- platform/social/video result: 2

## Aggregate structure for fetched pages

- Avg word count: 2481.0
- Avg internal links: 43.8
- Avg external links: 7.0
- has_pricing_cost: 96%
- has_faq: 71%
- has_case_study_proof: 99%
- has_clear_cta: 99%
- has_step_process: 95%
